tips.text: Skip Phase 1: ignore his drone's three ambushes and run into the next tile, which must be his next spawn point, not a dead end.
In a squad only one player needs to reach the next tile for the skip to work.
Watch the minimap right before he spawns; it briefly shows the correct exit.
Bring a splash weapon such as Tonkor, Sonicor, Ignis or Kuva Ogris with Nightwatch Napalm; it hits his small weak spots reliably.
Slow him with Molecular Prime, Rhino Stomp, Avalanche or Temporal Drag so the weak spots are easy to aim at.
Dump damage once he boards the Terra Frame; that phase is fully vulnerable.
Check whether Hydroid is up in the Circuit before a long Systems drought, though the boss is faster unless your luck is bad.
Expect Systems droughts of 25 runs or more; at 22.56% they are normal luck.
Once you know the Phase 1 skip, a full set takes anywhere from a handful of runs to an hour or two.
